name: Drop + Matt3o MT3 /dev/tty
description: Matt3o's original MT3 set: dye-sub PBT in cream and charcoal, modeled on IBM beamspring caps. Double-shot ABS retooling came later, on other Drop MT3 releases — the 2017 /dev/tty run itself shipped dye-sub to avoid the far higher tooling cost of double-shot legends. The set that defined the MT3 profile and remains the reference build for tall, sculpted typing.
